memberdef.name: SCCPSolver

briefdescription.para: markBlockExecutable - This method can be used by clients to mark all of the blocks that are known to be intrinsically live in the processed unit.

detaileddescription.para: This returns true if the block was not considered live before.

briefdescription.para: trackValueOfGlobalVariable - Clients can use this method to inform the SCCPSolver that it should track loads and stores to the specified global variable if it can.

detaileddescription.para: This is only legal to call if performing Interprocedural SCCP.

briefdescription.para: addTrackedFunction - If the SCCP solver is supposed to track calls into and out of the specified function (which cannot have its address taken), this method must be called.
Add function to the list of functions whose return cannot be modified.
Returns true if the return of the given function cannot be modified.
Returns true if the given function is in the solver's set of argument-tracked functions.
Solve - Solve for constants and executable blocks.
resolvedUndefsIn - While solving the dataflow for a function, we assume that branches on undef values cannot reach any of their successors.

detaileddescription.para: However, this is not a safe assumption. After we solve dataflow, this method should be use to handle this. If this returns true, the solver should be rerun.

briefdescription.para: Invalidate the Lattice Value of Call and its users after specializing the call.
getTrackedRetVals - Get the inferred return value map.
getTrackedGlobals - Get and return the set of inferred initializers for global variables.
getMRVFunctionsTracked - Get the set of functions which return multiple values tracked by the pass.
markOverdefined - Mark the specified value overdefined.

detaileddescription.para: This works with both scalars and structs.

briefdescription.para: trackValueOfArgument - Mark the specified argument overdefined unless it have range attribute.

detaileddescription.para: This works with both scalars and structs.

briefdescription.para: Helper to return a Constant if LV is either a constant or a constant range with a single element.
Return either a Constant or nullptr for a given Value.
Set the Lattice Value for the arguments of a specialization F.

detaileddescription.para: If an argument is Constant then its lattice value is marked with the corresponding actual argument in Args. Otherwise, its lattice value is inherited (copied) from the corresponding formal argument in Args.

briefdescription.para: Mark all of the blocks in function F non-executable.

detaileddescription.para: Clients can used this method to erase a function from the module (e.g., if it has been completely specialized and is no longer needed).

briefdescription.para: SCCPSolver - This interface class is a general purpose solver for Sparse Conditional Constant Propagation (SCCP).
